character_spec.geometry: Fresh 36-point registered 3D face-mask silhouette projected via smoothPath; 342 individually bounded native dry-pencil contacts in 3 families + 4 translucent construction guides.

five_axes.topology: one editable standalone head, no old portrait parts and no face stickers. Mark visible missing cranium behind the mask as blocker, not as finished skull.
five_axes.vector_flow: 3 curved local pressure fans run from forehead through zygomatic bones to jaw; no global diagonal identical strokes
five_axes.weight: low pressure ochre/rose/sepia head plane values; subtle mandibular and zygomatic turn, not solid gradient contour
five_axes.rhythm: 3 × 114 short strokes follow three bony guides with deterministic irregular offsets, not wallpaper
five_axes.texture: 3 independent CP-F1 skin-material pigment passes over paper tooth with no bitmap, image filters or external media
